gloss: one round; one size (bigger/smaller); one cycle (of zodiac)

definitions.gloss: one round, one lap, full circuit
definitions.explanation: Going around something once, completing a full circle or tour.
A noticeable difference in size, used to describe something or someone as distinctly larger or smaller than a reference point.
A full cycle of the Chinese zodiac, equal to 12 years. Used when describing age differences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went around the park once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: I took a walk around the town and came back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a day to make one tour of the tourist spots.

examples.japanese: {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give me one size larger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother is noticeably bigger than me.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This shirt feels like it shrank a size.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧だ。
examples.english: My husband is one zodiac cycle (12 years) older than me.

examples.japanese: {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{年下|としした}→年下：07303_toshishita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I married a junior colleague who is 12 years younger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{干支|えと}→干支：12449_eto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: She and I share the same zodiac sign but are one full cycle apart.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 is very common in everyday speech. {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ and {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧ are the most frequent collocations. The size difference is approximate and subjective rather than a precise measurement.

Sense 3 specifically refers to the 12-year Chinese zodiac cycle (⟦{干支|えと}→干支：12449_eto⟧). {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧/⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ is a common way to describe a 12-year age gap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: one size bigger
- {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: one size smaller
- {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: 12 years older
- {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧: 12 years younger
- {一回|ひとまわ}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go around once
